title.zh: 为驻马尼拉市的菲律宾宪兵队军官及电报检查员提供实物住房未予配给时以现金折算住房津贴的法案
title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR COMMUTATION OF QUARTERS FOR OFFICERS OF THE PHILIPPINES CONSTABULARY AND TELEGRAPHIC INSPECTORS ASSIGNED TO DUTY IN THE CITY OF MANILA, WHEN QUARTERS IN KIND ARE NOT FURNISHED TO THEM.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR COMMUTATION OF QUARTERS FOR OFFICERS OF THE PHILIPPINES CONSTABULARY AND TELEGRAPHIC INSPECTORS ASSIGNED TO DUTY IN THE CITY OF MANILA, WHEN QUARTERS IN KIND ARE NOT FURNISHED TO THEM.
title.vi: Đạo luật quy định việc thanh toán tiền ở thay thế cho sĩ quan Cảnh sát Lực lượng Vũ trang Philippines và thanh tra điện tín được phân công làm nhiệm vụ tại Thành phố Manila khi không được bố trí nhà ở thực tế
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดให้มีการชดเชยที่พักสำหรับนายทหารกองกำลังตำรวจฟิลิปปินส์และผู้ตรวจสอบโทรเลขซึ่งปฏิบัติงานในนครมะนิลาเมื่อไม่มีการจัดหาที่พักในรูปแบบของสิ่งของ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengatur komutasi tempat tinggal bagi perwira Kepolisian Filipina dan inspektur telegraf yang ditugaskan bertugas di Kota Manila apabila tempat tinggal dalam bentuk barang tidak disediakan bagi mereka
title.ms: Akta menyediakan komutasi tempat tinggal bagi pegawai Polis Filipina dan pemeriksa telegraf yang ditugaskan bertugas di Bandar Manila apabila tempat tinggal dalam bentuk barang tidak dibekalkan kepada mereka

text.en:
Officers of the Philippines Constabulary and inspectors of Philippines Constabulary in the
telegraphic division assigned to duty in the city of Manila, when not furnished quarters in kind, shall
hereafter be entitled to commutation of quarters at the rate of fifteen dollars, United States currency, per
month, during the period in which they may be so assigned: Provided, however, That, the benefits of this
section shall not accrue to officers of the Philippines Constabulary detailed from the Army of the United

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall be effective as of January first, nineteen hundred and three, and shall make valid all
commutations of quarters made within its provisions since that date.
Enacted, March 28, 1903.
